flawed_step: The statement incorrectly equates single-vertex local optimality with global optimality.
counterexample: Let G be the 4-cycle with edges {12,23,34,41}. Take the partition {1,2} | {3,4}. Its cut value is 2 (edges 23 and 41). Every vertex has one neighbor on its own side and one on the other side, so moving any single vertex leaves the cut value at 2; thus no single-vertex move strictly improves it. However, the partition {1,3} | {2,4} cuts all four edges and has value 4. Therefore the original partition is not a maximum cut.
assessment_summary: A 4-cycle has a single-vertex-stable cut of value 2 even though its maximum cut value is 4.
